description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Whether payments needs to be collected automatically for this customer. Possible values are : on, off.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → auto_collection[is] = "on"

is.description: \* \`on\` - Whenever an invoice is created, an automatic attempt to charge the customer's payment method is made. \* \`off\` - Automatic collection of charges will not be made. All payments must be recorded offline.

is_not.description: \* \`on\` - Whenever an invoice is created, an automatic attempt to charge the customer's payment method is made. \* \`off\` - Automatic collection of charges will not be made. All payments must be recorded offline.
